evidence.detail: Exact v308 recognizes @par@ plus par/par2..par8 tags and pimg/p2img..p8img image-selector forms inside the RSFont rich-text pipeline.
For an active particle markup span the class counts particle controls, resolves the selected pimg family, and chooses up to three unique random palette/image variants with a 50 ms cache window.

Its render-side method computes randomized positions within the supplied glyph/text bounds, constructs the already-recovered UI particle object rs/l/f/a/f/a, assigns direction/motion/size/alpha/lifetime state and registers it with the active particle manager.
R55 RSFont invokes the parser during both layout and drawing, tracks the selected par mode and palette array, and calls the particle-spawn method at matching rendered character positions.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for par/pimg rich-text markup that emits UI particles from RSFont rendering.
